name: Mesa Police Cadet Post 2055
what_you_do: Go to weekly meetings with hands-on police training. Learn about traffic stops and how police investigate. Do community service.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 19, and you must have finished 8th grade. Stay in school until you graduate. Keep a 2.0 GPA or higher. No serious police record.
pay_detail: Pay is not stated on the program page. No fee is listed.
deadline_text: The post recruits twice a year. The program page says the next recruitment window is October 2025.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online interest form on the Mesa cadet page. A cadet advisor then contacts you. For help, call 480-644-4869 or email PDCadets@mesaaz.gov.
notes: Members can stay in the Post until they turn 21. Cadets also do community service. Ask the post for the next recruiting date.
